description: Synthetic fixture mapping, not a public mapping language or fulfilment policy.
identity_rule: Entity IDs copy source order/unit/shipment identifiers. Relation IDs join the fixed relation role and those identifiers with colons.
transformation: Copy values without normalization. Relation kinds come from this mapping; their derivations cite the source association, not a claim that the enum text occurs verbatim.
locator_convention: row:N:field, zero-based JSONL row; unit_ids[i] selects the indexed physical unit.
query_scope: Remaining units are the order-unit set minus units linked through this order's retained shipments. This is not a delivery, stock, over-allocation or source-truth check.
